title: Validation of Client Build Version
author: Tai BUI, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Build-number validation and preemptive client quit technique

historical_commentary.text: The underlying concern — mismatched 4D Client/Server builds of the same version causing subtle errors, since 4D doesn't strongly enforce build-level matching — is a real, still-applicable operational risk in classic 4D Client/Server deployments; the specific validation technique remains usable, though it is a narrower concern for solutions that have moved away from mixed on-prem Client/Server topologies toward web/ORDA-based clients.
related_updates: Applies primarily to classic 4D Client/Server (4D Remote) deployments; less directly relevant to REST/ORDA/web-client architectures where client 'build' is a browser or app version rather than a 4D Client build
